message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: HVCC Build

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build-linux:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            arch: x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            arch: aarch64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: true
      - name: Initialize lfs
        run: git lfs pull
      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: 3.12
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install poetry poetry-pyinstaller-plugin pyinstaller
      - name: Build binaries
        run: |
          pip install .
          poetry build

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: heavy-binary-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: dist/pyinstaller/linux_${{ matrix.arch }}/Heavy

  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: true
      - name: Initialize lfs
        run: git lfs pull
      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: 3.12
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install poetry poetry-pyinstaller-plugin pyinstaller
      - name: Build binaries
        run: |
          pip install .
          poetry build

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: heavy-binary-windows-x86_64
          path: dist/pyinstaller/win_amd64/Heavy.exe

  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-15-intel
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: true
      - name: Initialize lfs
        run: git lfs pull
      - name: Set up Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: 3.12
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml', 'poetry.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install poetry poetry-pyinstaller-plugin pyinstaller
      - name: Build binaries
        run: |
          pip install .
          poetry build

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: heavy-binary-macos-x86_64
          path: dist/pyinstaller/macosx_15_0_x86_64/Heavy",
  "rationale": "Every job repeatedly fetches and installs the same Python build dependencies (pip, setuptools, wheel, poetry, poetry-pyinstaller-plugin, pyinstaller, and the project itself) from the network. The repository has both pyproject.toml and poetry.lock, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching; cache inputs include lockfile and environment). Adding an actions/cache@v4 step for the pip cache, keyed on runner OS plus hashes of pyproject.toml and poetry.lock, reuses downloaded dependencies across runs while preserving all build steps, artifacts, and required checks. The pattern reports a measured modest VM-time benefit, and the matching experiment example showed adding the same pip cache step reduced elapsed time by about 9.2% with all tests still passing. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no publishing/deployment or new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
